# Pixel8 Media Solutions

> Johannesburg photography and design studio. Events and celebrations (matric dances, weddings, graduations, birthdays, corporate functions), commercial and product photography, and portraits. Founded by Rayhaan Cassim, co-led with Muhammad Chopdat.

- Website: https://www.pixel8media.co.za/
- Based in: Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa; works across South Africa
- Email: pixel8.za@gmail.com
- Phone and WhatsApp: +27 73 015 4475
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pixel.8_/

## Services

- [Events & Celebrations](https://www.pixel8media.co.za/#services): matric dances, weddings, birthdays and corporate functions. Full-day coverage, second shooter, same-week previews.
- [Commercial & Product](https://www.pixel8media.co.za/#services): catalogue and campaign imagery for brands, storefronts and menus. Studio or on-site, consistent framing across a range, web and print exports.
- [Portraits & Shoots](https://www.pixel8media.co.za/#services): matric farewell, couples, family and professional headshots. Location scouting, wardrobe guidance, retouched selects.

## Service pages

- [Matric dance photography](https://www.pixel8media.co.za/matric-dance-photographer-johannesburg): send-offs at home, cars, couple and group portraits; group bookings for several families.
- [Wedding photography](https://www.pixel8media.co.za/wedding-photographer-johannesburg): getting ready to send-off, second shooter available, proposals.
- [Graduation photography](https://www.pixel8media.co.za/graduation-photographer-johannesburg): campus portraits and family photos straight after the ceremony.

## How booking works

- [Process](https://www.pixel8media.co.za/#process): 1) Enquire and receive a written quote. 2) Plan the shot list, timings and locations. 3) Shoot, with previews within the week. 4) Deliver a private online gallery with full-resolution downloads and web-sized copies.
- [Contact](https://www.pixel8media.co.za/#contact): enquiries are answered within one working day.
